slides.title: What a Poor Squeegee Does to Your Print
slides.lead: Solder paste printing drives first-pass yield, and the squeegee is one of the factors you can control most easily.
items: Worn or bent blade edge leaves pads short
Paste sticks to the blade and drops into apertures
Poor end dams let paste dry and clog the stencil
Holder not flat, blade pressure uneven
Screws, clamps and pieces to clean on every change
No fixed place, no record of wear
slides.notes: From SM 'squeegee improving solution' (holder flatness, assembly, dead corners, end-dam spill dries in 6-8 h, blade toughness, edge treatment, wetting) and SM squeegee deck (incomplete, spill, deviation, icicles).
